review_scope: Read principal TeX statements and relevant sections across all 26 archives; searched all extracted TeX/Markdown for proposed new obstruction claims. This inventories what reports claim, not independent certification of every theorem or computational certificate.

reports.title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: Heavenly elliptic curves, critical-line Euler products, and geometric progressions
reports.report_claims: Four papers: uniform Rasmussen–Tamagawa bounds for A4/A5 sextic fields; B(1)=4027 and 29 necessary prime candidates; O’Hara cubic finiteness questions; general odd-degree descent; paired moving-height Euler product limits and short-log-window mean square; signed-zero-spectrum inversion; periodic geometric-progression construction.
reports.remaining_obligations: Attainment of heavenly prime bound; all-cutoff ordinary fixed-center deep RH; stronger progression gap bounds.
reports.audit_caution: Several claims use only classical arithmetic and existing unconditional results, rather than internal GRH proof machinery.

reports.title: What Dirichlet GRH settles beyond the zero theorem
reports.report_claims: Prime plus positive multiple of a prime cube: exact threshold 10500 and 62 exceptions; Barthel–Müller geometric-interval conjecture for every integer exponent t≥2; uniform Momose type-2 prime list of 66 primes ≤253507 for A4/A5 sextic fields; alternating subset-action criterion; exact congruence approximation.
reports.remaining_obligations: First geometric interval; Pomerance divisibility conjecture; actual isogeny occurrence beyond local necessary tests; nonabelian covolume inequality.
reports.audit_caution: Prime/isogeny conclusions are new deductions claimed by this report from imported analytic results; certificates are necessary conditions where explicitly stated.

reports.title: The 432 imaginary quadratic fields of class-group exponent six
reports.report_claims: Claims complete 432-field and 1236-order exponent-six census; 28 split primes below 5500 force repeated norm coefficient, followed by 9393302 finite candidates; prime-gap graph growth; exact quintic reflection-field conductors; simultaneous test for six nonabelian zetas.
reports.remaining_obligations: Exponent-seven census; improved graph matching size; arithmetic estimate for quintic splitting detector.
reports.audit_caution: Must not repeat earlier reports saying exponent-six census still unresolved: this later archive claims completion. No independent replay of its 9-million-case computation here.

reports.title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: Coefficient fields of CM newforms and one-sided prime estimates
reports.report_claims: Claims exactly 26 quintic CM weight-two coefficient fields, 31 septic fields, odd-prime-degree classification; even-weight genus-field inclusion; Grosswald and norm-Euclidean applications; simultaneous weighted races; cubic root-count RH equivalence.
reports.remaining_obligations: Quartic CM coefficient-field overlap/classification; nonabelian cubic arithmetic bound.
reports.audit_caution: CM prime-degree classification invokes unconditional class-number and CM literature; local quintic conductor question addressed by later exponent-six report.

reports.title: What Dirichlet GRH settles: A classification of abelian fields, short representations, and a test for nonabelian fields
reports.report_claims: 229 abelian fields satisfying Zhao zero-sum sufficient condition; degree≤8 and discriminant<193000000 frontier under field RH; short xy+yz+zx representations; K3–Enriques obstruction application; Kummer irreducible-prime criterion; exact upper endpoint of smoothed split-prime error.
reports.remaining_obligations: Nonabelian prime estimate; full general-field classification beyond sufficient condition.
reports.audit_caution: The 229 list classifies a sufficient spectral condition, not every possible Mertens-error property.

reports.title: Two-pattern detectors for nonabelian Riemann hypotheses: An A6 transfer
reports.report_claims: Degree-90 and degree-45 monomial Artin factors and degree-90 subfield zeta detector; exact character identities, scope-specific optimality, multiplicity inequalities, dyadic criteria, concrete sextic certificate.
reports.remaining_obligations: Square-root-accuracy prime inequality / matching theta arithmetic.
reports.audit_caution: Explicitly a reduction, not A6 RH; optimalities are relative to prescribed character/support classes.

reports.title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: Arithmetic transfers and comparison theorems
reports.report_claims: Sharp finite-budget common torsion nonvanishing; bounded-power-series extension of valuation approximation; determinantal/Fitting bounds; exact odd-cocycle direct-limit identification with a conjugation eigenspace of locally trivial H1.
reports.remaining_obligations: Arbitrary eigenform isolation; new representation local/inertia hypotheses; Vandiver parity; K-theory and nonabelian prime arithmetic.
reports.audit_caution: No major conjecture solved; standard-cohomology comparison is a paper proof, not Lean-compiled.

reports.title: Sparse equations for singular moduli and the sign of weighted prime sums
reports.report_claims: Complete four-term exclusion in degree≥4; one-prime Riffaut proof; support growth ≥D^(1/4−ε) and GRH square-root class-number bound; Suzuki sign switch Q=138/139; >99.677% negative-error density; simultaneous convex prime-error balancing.
reports.remaining_obligations: At that stage five-term −131 unrestricted width; sharper support growth.
reports.audit_caution: Later sparse-moduli archives claim to close all five-term residual cases.

reports.title: Singular moduli, prime-generating constants, and sparse zero detection
reports.report_claims: Support growth ≫D^(1/4)/sqrt(log D); four-term classification degree≥6 with 79 degree-4/5 residuals; 7959-term integer certificate; corrected least prime-generating constants for exponents 9/4 through 2.01; prime cube/fourth power exceptions; sparse twist/scale criterion.
reports.remaining_obligations: 79 residual CM cases and further support improvement at that stage.
reports.audit_caution: Residual CM cases are subsequently claimed solved; constant certificates depend on imported explicit short-interval estimates.

reports.title: Sparse equations for singular moduli
reports.report_claims: Local p-adic sparse-root estimate; complete four-term classification; support ≫h/(log D)^2 and exponent limit 1/2 under GRH; unconditional exponent 1/2−1/(4sqrt(e))−ε; full-support infinite family; five-term reduction to −87,−131,−348,−432,−675 and width≤65536 exclusion.
reports.remaining_obligations: All exponent widths at five residual discriminants then open.
reports.audit_caution: Later grh_sparse_singular_moduli archive claims to remove width bound and solve full five-term classification.

reports.title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: Cyclic-generator prime races and linear auxiliary windows
reports.report_claims: Sylow-generator cyclic filters detect nonabelian zeros via Heilbronn characters without Artin holomorphy; prime-order patterns for Sn/An; six-pattern S8 example; linear auxiliary log window [t,Lt] with simultaneous convexification.
reports.remaining_obligations: New Frobenius-sensitive covolume estimate.
reports.audit_caution: Detector and linear-window methods already developed here; no nonabelian RH proved.

reports.title: Positive Frobenius deficits and a finite-difference route beyond Dirichlet GRH
reports.report_claims: Nonnegative deficit, finite-difference and averaged-positive-part zero criteria; optimal lift modulo abelian class functions; two-class S4 detector; Kummer nonresidue detector; normalized holomorphic modular forms and symmetric-power analytic criteria.
reports.remaining_obligations: Geometric arithmetic bound for new nonnegative traces and losses.
reports.audit_caution: Symmetric-power mention is analytic only; no treatment of scalar-inertia obstruction for symmetric powers found.

reports.title: Polynomial auxiliary scales and Kummer prime races beyond Dirichlet GRH
reports.report_claims: Linear logarithmic auxiliary window and finite-error common convexification; prime-index Kummer fixed-log-window positive-block criterion; argument deriving Artin–Hooley density for primitive root 2 from prime-index RH plus sieve.
reports.remaining_obligations: One-sided arithmetic bound per prime-index block; uniformity for quantitative versions.
reports.audit_caution: Explicitly does not prove Artin’s conjecture.

reports.title: Beyond RH and Dirichlet GRH: Source review and transfer analysis
reports.report_claims: Source audit; exact covolume loss lemma; sufficiently populous auxiliary-prime subfamilies; principal-ideal cubic discriminant −23 target; finite cubic illustrations.
reports.remaining_obligations: Class-sensitive divisibility, matching heights, twist and determinant estimates.
reports.audit_caution: Lean draft uncompiled; repository source identity and numerical illustrations not kernel verification.

reports.title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: Averaged zero detection and exact K-theory transfer tests
reports.report_claims: Positive-part Mellin criterion; dyadic L1/L2 variants; signed moving-window criterion and grid counterexample; rank-sensitive determinant loss; gcd-of-lcm certificate aggregation; quadratic special-value unit tests e=54..80; exact comparison-space dimensions and two Hecke reconstructions.
reports.remaining_obligations: Selmer-to-Hecke bridge and certified determinants for new K-groups; cubic bound in mean.
reports.audit_caution: Unit screens and small Hecke matrices do not prove K-group vanishing; cannot replace gcd-of-lcm quantifiers by simpler gcd.

reports.title: Beyond the Dirichlet GRH endpoint: Transferable arithmetic, a nonabelian certificate, and additional class-group exclusions
reports.report_claims: Finite/infinite bounded p-adic family torsion selector; matrix inverse control; explicit A5 positive detector and exact abelian-congruence obstruction; four intermediate-genus exponent-six exclusions; rank-two scalar-inertia obstruction.
reports.remaining_obligations: New A5 prime bound; arithmetic family hypotheses; then-open exponent-six census (later claimed closed).
reports.audit_caution: Scalar-inertia obstruction already covers elliptic rank-two Tate modules, their Tate twists and duals. No symmetric-power general theorem or congruenceTerm infinity argument found.

reports.title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: Transfer mechanisms, exact obstructions, and a concrete cubic target
reports.report_claims: Optimal fixed-congruence approximation for any finite Galois group; fourth-power finite-sum nonabelian RH criterion and exact interpolation loss; compulsory ramification budget εe≥2|Q|ℓ^floor(logℓm); bounded number of ramification pairs.
reports.remaining_obligations: Fixed-module descent needed for Selmer vanishing; cubic root-count bound at all scales.
reports.audit_caution: Fourth-power sampling and Specht-ratio ingredients identified as existing; no theorem derives vanishing from arbitrarily small normalized lengths.

reports.title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: Polynomial Order-Exponent Bounds for Simultaneous p-adic Twisting
reports.report_claims: Degree-independent polynomial upper order-exponent bound via multiplicative shell potential; positive fraction of admissible primitive roots on one shell; multivariate/bounded-series and common-conductor arithmetic packets.
reports.remaining_obligations: Application to new arithmetic representations still requires full source hypotheses; exact optimality and further quantitative refinements.
reports.audit_caution: A genuine refinement of internal mechanism; not a known named conjecture resolution.

reports.title: Reflection detectors for nonabelian Riemann hypotheses
reports.report_claims: Heilbronn multiplicity detector for Sn fixed field of a transposition; bound ord ζL≤2(n−Hn)ord ζE; real-reflection-group variants; identity/transposition one-sided prime criterion and S5 example.
reports.remaining_obligations: Corresponding arithmetic inequality.
reports.audit_caution: No general Artin holomorphy assumed; reduction only.

reports.title: Relative zeta zeros from compressed prime races
reports.report_claims: Positive entire relative-Dedekind combinations; tower compression to constant-free prime-only integer-scale tests; S4 X4−X−1 weights 8 and −1 on split and 1·3; mixed compositum factors.
reports.remaining_obligations: Frobenius-selective divisibility and matching theta/covolume estimates.
reports.audit_caution: Conditional research interface, not nonabelian zero theorem.

reports.title: Sparse equations for singular moduli
reports.report_claims: Claims complete five-term iff degree≤4 classification, exact six-term minimum for quintic singular moduli; all-width finite-field certificates incl. −131; near-degree GRH growth; exact infinite full-support family; >61.33% lower density for Gaussian prime conductors; Frobenius support/minimax theorem.
reports.remaining_obligations: Seven-term lower bound for degree≥6; s≥c h uniformly; exact Gaussian density; X4−2 arithmetic deficit estimate.
reports.audit_caution: Full five-term claim supersedes earlier finite-width partial results; these are paper proofs plus finite certificates, not Lean results.

reports.title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: Sylow-filtered prime races and a two-pattern test
reports.report_claims: General commutator-Sylow signed detector with quantitative Heilbronn inequality; PSL2(7) split/involution weights 21 and −1; two quadratic Hecke factors over degree-21 field.
reports.remaining_obligations: New covolume/prime-sum inequality.
reports.audit_caution: No arbitrary nonabelian RH or Artin holomorphy claimed.

reports.title: Analysis of lsernau/grh-lean: Transfer principles and a cubic target
reports.report_claims: Original source and trust-boundary audit; standard consequences; quantitative determinant comparison; one-sided transform criterion; cubic discriminant −23 benchmark; seven small checked Lean lemmas in prior package.
reports.remaining_obligations: Principal-ideal-sensitive geometry and full new arithmetic input.
reports.audit_caution: Small Lean lemmas and source checks do not constitute a fresh verification of whole upstream proof.

reports.title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: A source audit and a research transfer map
reports.report_claims: De Bruijn–Newman zero and norm-Euclidean applications; reusable one-sided transform criterion; sufficiently populous auxiliary family; explicit positive tensor-square S3 target; K-theory ramification and quantifier gaps.
reports.remaining_obligations: Cubic arithmetic plus twist separation; strict Selmer–Hecke comparison for K-theory.
reports.audit_caution: No automatic Tate-module/K-group bridge; standard endpoint consequences distinguished.

reports.title: From Dirichlet GRH to class groups and prime races
reports.report_claims: Partial exponent-six classification ω≤6 or cofactor≤1e8; exact count 429 in first family, all known 432 in union; exponent-five list; exact beta-character race sign threshold; cubic level-23 prime-race RH equivalence.
reports.remaining_obligations: At that stage complete exponent-six census; other sign-dominating Artin/modular examples; cubic arithmetic.
reports.audit_caution: Later exponent-six archive claims full census, so this should be treated as a predecessor rather than current frontier.

reports.title: Beyond Dirichlet GRH: Sharp nonabelian transfer theorems for PSL2(2^r)
reports.report_claims: Minimal nonnegative genuine detector W of degree q² containing each irreducible once; optimal one/two subfield degree thresholds; exact root-count one-sided criterion; checks q=4,8,16.
reports.remaining_obligations: Arithmetic establishment of root-pattern inequality.
reports.audit_caution: Scope-specific optimality; no nonabelian RH solved.
